name: moinax
title: Moinax
description: The desktop surfaces that had no native equivalent: dev workspaces, worktrees, system toggles, windows, audio, wallpapers and keybindings.
author: moinax

commands.name: dev
commands.title: Dev Project
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Pick a project and open its herdr dev workspace.

commands.name: t3
commands.title: T3 Code
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Pick a project and open or create a T3 Code thread in it.

commands.name: kill-window
commands.title: Kill Window
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: List open windows and close or force-kill one.

commands.name: keyboard-layout
commands.title: Keyboard Layout
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Switch the compositor keyboard layout; the active one is marked.

commands.name: monitors
commands.title: Monitors
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Enable or disable connected outputs, one per action.

commands.name: browser
commands.title: Browser
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Pick an installed browser to open; the system default is marked.

commands.name: wallpaper
commands.title: Wallpaper
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Pick a wallpaper from ~/Wallpapers and apply it through awww.

commands.name: keybindings
commands.title: Keybindings
commands.subtitle: Moinax
commands.description: Search the compositor keybindings, grouped by section.

preferences.name: wallpaperDir
preferences.title: Wallpaper Directory
preferences.description: Directory the Wallpaper command lists images from.
